invite-bonus-body:
Once your registration is approved, you receive a personal invite code.

• Invite 3 friends who pass the same anti-abuse screening → +30 QAU bonus, up to 2 rounds (+60 QAU max)
• Bonus pool: 60,000 QAU, first come first served
• Fair play: if an invitee is flagged as sybil, that round is voided — your own airdrop is never affected
• Bonus tokens may be rewarded subject to pool availability
• Invite bonus accrual closes Dec 8, 2026 23:59 UTC
